programs.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programs.sub_title: The Nectar Of The Mayan Gods
programs.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Mani to learn about something sacred to the Mayans: bees and honey. She makes sweet lime roasted chicken with broccolini.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: A celebration of the Italian Sunday tradition, where Nonna's table brings together family, tradition, and irresistible flavours from slow-cooked sugo to crispy festive sweets.

programs.title: Italian Food Safari
programs.desc: Guy meets Lina and Antonio Siciliano, who've created a vast veggie and herb garden in Melbourne. Meanwhile, Maeve visits friends in Adelaide to explore large-scale prosciutto curing.

programs.title: America The Bountiful
programs.desc: Chiles are the backbone of Southwestern cuisine and are celebrated throughout the region.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine demonstrates how to make tasty marinara balls in tomato sauce and some fillo chocolate croissants. Adam Liaw makes his sweet almond pudding with poached apricots.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: It's Refugee Week on The Cook Up. Fashion designer Anjilla Seddeqi and Refugee Council Ambassador Lizzy Kuoth join Adam to share the food that is always on their tables.

programs.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programs.desc: Eva Longoria shows us around her adopted second hometown, Mexico City. This is where she met her husband, Pepe, and where they love to spend time with their son, Santi.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize
programs.desc: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: The remaining five bakers must rise to the occasion as they bake chocolate bread and use it to make a dessert deli sandwich. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers look to the silver screen.

programs.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
programs.desc: Victor shows how easy it is to make fresh noodles at home: all you need is flour, water and a little bit of time!

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programs.desc: It is one tropical surprise after another when Adam takes to the road around Rockhampton, beginning his trip at a petrol station known for making the best crab sandwiches in QLD.

programs.title: Flat Out Food
programs.desc: Jenn discovers how lentils are a popular Saskatchewan crop that's often just shipped overseas. A farmer, a brewer and a chef are changing that for the better.
